name: plate greaves
_design_note: F50-100 heavy legs slot. Full plate cuisse, poleyn, greave from hip to ankle. Pairs with plate/full plate body. Lighter than legacy 6 lb spec — the existing 6 lb assumed lower-quality articulation; modern entry assumes the engineered hinge that justifies a real plate suit.
lore_template: Full {material_name} plate leg protection — cuisse over the thigh, articulated poleyn at the knee, fluted greave to the ankle, all working in mechanical harmony. The engineering required to make these bend with a wearer without binding is a century of accumulated armorsmithing refinement, every line of every flute earning its place.
